snippet.title: AZUR - Official Gameplay Trailer | Insider Gaming Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the official gameplay trailer for AZUR, revealed at the Insider Gaming Showcase 2026.

AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on a fictional Mediterranean island. Fight, loot and survive  because when you die, you can lose everything.

Wishlist on Steam : AZUR

Coming to PC in 2027.

#AZUR #SurvivalFPS #IndieGame
